decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - No works shall take place until full details of the proposed restoration including 1:20 scale elevations/plans , including the design of the railings have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The works shall be implemented in strict accordance with the agreed details and maintained as such thereafter.

Condition : 3 - No works shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the patterns, moulds, ironworks and railings to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the works hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The works shall be carried out in strict accordancewith the approved details.

Condition : 4 - This consent does not permit the demolition or dismantling of any part of the memorial, or the removal of any feature, floor, except in so far as the alterations and restoration hereby approved necessitate the removal of certain parts of the existing structure.

Condition : 5 - Prior to the commencement of and during each stage of the development a detailed description of the steps and works to be taken and carried out in relation to the restoration and cleaning of the memorial, including full details of the biocide shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing and the development shall thereafter be undertaken in accordance with the approved scheme.

Condition : 6 - No work permitted by this consent shall commence until a detailed specification of the proposed mortar mix has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall be carried out using the approved specification
Condition : 7 - Angle grinders or other mechanical cutting tools shall not be used for      cutting out of stonework, brickwork and / or chasing out for repointing.

Condition : 8 - No work permitted by this consent shall commence until details of the extent of repointing has been agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall be carried out using the approved details.
description: Listed building consent for the restoration of the grave of Ugo Foscolo in the graveyard of St Nicholas with St Mary Magdalene Church.
